verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility allowing reuse of standard Postgres drivers/clients, which underlies ORM support, but there are no documented framework-specific guides for Prisma, Drizzle, Django, or Rails in the pack, and a community report notes missing array-column support that can break Postgres-based ORM compatibility. missing for 10: dedicated ORM/framework quickstart guides (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails), confirmation of full type/feature parity needed by these ORMs, and independent hands-on reports of successful ORM integration.
